conditioned_strain.capture: Final conditioned strain supplied to StrainSegments before Fourier transforms

gating_info.hash_encoding: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, separators (comma, colon), NumPy values converted to lists

psd_arrays.capture: Exact final segment.psd before overwhitening; no rescaling or dtype conversion

validity.excluded_infinity_policy: Positive infinity is allowed only outside the actual filter slice; inverse-spectrum truncation can produce it where the inverse spectrum vanishes.

segment_geometry.sample_origin: Offsets relative to strain_start_time; intervals are half-open.

purpose: Untimed pycbc_inspiral qualification; all instrumented timing fields are invalid for benchmarking.
